title: Add UI Library
description: Install Panda CSS + Ark UI (or Tailwind + shadcn/ui) into libs/shared/ui, wire it into an app, apply theming.

appName.description: The app slug under apps/ to wire the UI library into. Omit to auto-discover the single app under apps/.

library.description: UI library choice. Default is Panda CSS + Ark UI; shadcn/Tailwind is an opt-in escape hatch with classname-lint enforcement.

themingMode.description: Theming input mode: enter hex colors directly, or paste an existing theme (CSS vars / Panda token JSON, auto-detected).

primary.description: Primary hex color, e.g. #3b82f6. Required when themingMode is 'interactive'.

secondary.description: Secondary hex color, e.g. #111827. Required when themingMode is 'interactive'.

pasted.description: Pasted theme content (CSS vars block or Panda token JSON, auto-detected). Required when themingMode is 'paste'. Max 64KB.
